version_history.note: Pre-GA Realtime spec; replaced by 371f497… on 2026-05-08 to pick up GA Realtime sessions, Realtime Translation API, gpt-realtime-2/translate/whisper models, and transcription delay.
afacc434… replaced by a6fedde… on 2026-06-02 to pick up the Responses API additional_tools item type and the personality (PersonalityEnum) style preset on the input-token-count request.

a6fedde… replaced by 0161cb2… on 2026-06-05 to pick up moderation scores on the Responses API (Moderation) and Chat Completions API (ChatCompletionModeration): the `moderation` request param (ModerationParam) plus input/output moderation results, including on chat completion stream chunks.

0161cb2… replaced by b5b6210… on 2026-06-20 to pick up the Responses API reasoning context mode (Reasoning.context — which reasoning items are rendered back to the model on later turns) and the MCP tool Secure Tunnel ID (MCPTool.tunnel_id; connector_id also modeled, server_url now optional). Administration-only changes (AdminApiKey.expires_at, audit-log event types + tenant_only, spend-alert lookups) are excluded from coverage.

b5b6210… replaced by 356010b… on 2026-07-11 to pick up the GPT-5.6-era API surface: programmatic tool calling (ToolCallCaller/allowed_callers, Program/ProgramOutput items, programmatic_tool_calling tool + tool choice), explicit prompt caching (PromptCacheOptions, prompt_cache_breakpoint on content parts), reasoning mode (standard/pro) and max reasoning effort, moderation policy param, and the beta multi-agent Responses surface (Beta* schema family, ?beta=true endpoint variants gated by OpenAI-Beta: responses_multi_agent=v1). Webhook and admin-only additions are excluded from coverage.

356010b… replaced by 31fcc3c… on 2026-07-31 to pick up the July 2026 API surface: Fast mode service tier (service_tier: fast, replacing Priority Processing), the gpt-transcribe/gpt-live-transcribe transcription features (keywords, multi-language input, TranscriptionLanguage detection results), and the content provenance checks endpoint (POST /content_provenance_checks, C2PA/SynthID detection). Spend limits, service-account API keys, project API key owner_project_access, tenant.* audit-log events, and usage token detail fields are admin-only and excluded from coverage; the webhook schema swap (WebhookSafetyIdentifierBlocked removed, WebhookLiveCallIncoming added) is out of scope (no webhook support).
